timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Such responsibility to carefully select who deserves to win the titles.
Here are the judges that will evaluate the performances of our candidates.
First, we have one of the country's most gifted young actors,
making girls swoon on GMA Network, Mr. Kiko Estrada.
A certified hitmaker with numerous Golden Platinum record awards to his name,
he of course is an icon of the 80s and the 90s.
Please welcome Mr. Nagi Seng Ikau, Mr. Lui Herrera.
A Filipino-American physician dedicated to the advocacy of promoting the fight against
Colin Cancer, Dr. Noel Fajardo.
A Filipino-American MMA sensation from the picturesque city of Baguio,
fresh from his universal reality combat championship, featherweight triumph,
over his Korean foe, Mr. Mark Strigel.
A fashion and style coach, a certified image consultant, and the managing director of
Escario Fortuna, Ms. Taty Fortuna.
Australian-born Filipino Czech professional basketball player,
model TV host and forward player of San Miguel Bierman, David Semarad.
Medical specialist in gastroenterology,
authored more than 150 publications in the field of gastroenterology,
regular speaker and lecturer at the main meetings in the fields of gastroenterology
and internal medicine. He has received numerous awards for his research and activities in
Europe and in the US. Dr. Filipo Premonini.
Model beauty queen actress and endorser of the Blue Water Day Spa, Mrs. Arra Arida.
Beauty guru and certified skincare expert, whose expertise is sought by celebrities,
who wish to look their best. She is the president and CEO of Kathy Valencia's Skin and Body
Center, Ms. Kathy Valencia. A corporate social responsibility champion,
a sports enthusiast, the chief operating officer of Resorts World Manila,
and a Filipino at heart, Mr. Stephen Riley.
Architect responsible for the look of all of the bench stores,
architect Miguel Pastor.
Musician, model and beauty queen crowned as Miss World 2016, Miss Stephanie Del Valhi.
Austrian international model and bench international endorser,
Ivo Puchta. President and CEO of I face incorporated, Tony Chua.
Indian model and reigning queen of Miss World, Miss Manushi Chiller.
Vice President of Finance for Sui Incorporation, Mother Company of Bench, Miss Nenita Lim.
One of Singapore's top business leaders and the founder, CEO of GCOX, Global Cryptocurrency
offering exchange, Mr. Jeffrey Lynn.
Actress model and dorsor and the country's first ever Miss World, Miss Megan Young.
Former MMDH chairman now political advisor to President Rodrigo Deterreter,
Secretary Francis Tolentino.
Retired Filipino PNP General, former chief of the Philippine National Police and now director,
General of the Bureau of Corrections, General Ronald Batod de La Rossa.
A graduate of computer science and math from the University of San Francisco,
and then a post-grad in fashion design and merchandising from FIDM Los Angeles.
A trailblazer in the fields of business, education and social work.
She is a T-O-Y-M and a UNESCO awardee.
She is also a member of the board in the various Lucio-Tan group of companies,
the epitome of beauty and brains, Miss Vivian Tan.
Let's give them all a big round of applause.
Thank you so much judges for taking the time.

The Judges of the competition were as follows:

Kiko Estrada - actor

Louie Heredia - composer and hitmaker

Dr. Noel Fajardo - gastroenterologist

Mark Striegl - mixed martial artist fighter

Tati Fortuna - fashion designer

David Semerad - PBA basketball player

Dr. Filippo Cremonini - gastroenterologist

Ariella Arida - Miss Universe 2013 3rd Runner-up

Cathy Valencia - CEO, Cathy Valencia Advanced Skin Clinic

Stephen Reilly - CEO, Resorts World Manila

Arch. Miguel Pastor - architect

Stephanie Del Valle - Miss World 2016 from Puerto Rico

Ivo Buchta - Austrian international model

Tony Chua - President & CEO, iFace Inc.

Manushi Chhillar - Miss World 2017 from India

Nenita Lim - VP of Finance, Suyen Corporation

Jeffrey Lin - CEO, GCOX

Megan Young - Miss World Philippines 2013 and Miss World 2013

Sec. Francis Tolentino - Secretary and Presidential Adviser for Political Affairs

Gen. Ronald "Bato" Dela Rosa - former PNP chief and Current Director General of Bureau of Corrections

Vivienne Tan - Executive Vice President, Commercial Group at Philippine Airlines
